newsitem.title: USA: Home Depot sees "strong" 97 earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Home Depot sees "strong" 97 earnings growth.

text.p: Bolstered by a 32 percent jump in fourth quarter 1996 sales, Home Depot Inc said Tuesday it is looking forward to "another year of strong earnings growth in fiscal 1997."
In a statement accompanying its 1996 earnings report, Home Depot cited effective merchandising, efficient operations and customer service as reasons for the loyalty of its customers.
At the end of fiscal 1996, the company said it had a total of 512 stores.
During the fourth quarter of 1996, Home Depot said it opened 33 new stores and relocated two stores.
The company reported fiscal 1996 fourth quarter net earnings of $251 million or $0.52 per share compared to net earnings of $185 million or $0.39 per share in the fourth quarter of 1995.
First Call estimiated the company would report earnings of $0.49 per share for the quarter just ended.
